@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+FROM golang:1.25-bookworm AS build
+WORKDIR /src
+COPY go.mod go.sum ./
+RUN go mod download
+COPY . .
+RUN CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /px1d ./cmd/px1d
+
+FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
+COPY --from=build /px1d /px1d
+EXPOSE 8080
+USER nonroot:nonroot
+ENTRYPOINT ["/px1d"]

diff --git a/cmd/px1d/main.go b/cmd/px1d/main.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..882da76
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cmd/px1d/main.go
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"flag"
+	"log/slog"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"os/signal"
+	"syscall"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/getsentry/sentry-go"
+	"github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/http"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp"
+
+	hostedruntime "px1/internal/hosted/runtime"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	role := flag.String("role", "", "hosted process role")
+	flag.Parse()
+	cfg, err := hostedruntime.LoadConfig(*role)
+	if err != nil {
+		slog.Error("invalid configuration", "error", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
+	defer stop()
+	shutdownTelemetry, err := hostedruntime.StartTelemetry(ctx, cfg)
+	if err != nil {
+		slog.Error("telemetry startup failed", "error", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
+		defer cancel()
+		if err := shutdownTelemetry(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
+			slog.Error("telemetry shutdown failed", "error", err)
+		}
+	}()
+
+	mux := http.NewServeMux()
+	mux.HandleFunc("GET /healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent) })
+	mux.HandleFunc("GET /readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent) })
+	sentryMiddleware := sentryhttp.New(sentryhttp.Options{Repanic: true})
+	handler := otelhttp.NewHandler(sentryMiddleware.Handle(mux), "px1.http")
+	server := &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Address, Handler: handler, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
+	go func() {
+		<-ctx.Done()
+		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
+		defer cancel()
+		_ = server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
+	}()
+	slog.Info("hosted process ready", "role", cfg.Role, "environment", cfg.Environment, "release", cfg.Release)
+	if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
+		sentry.CaptureException(err)
+		slog.Error("server stopped", "error", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+}

index 0000000..80d453b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/deploy/fly/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+# Hosted deployment
+
+Staging and production are separate Fly applications and must use separate
+PostgreSQL, object-store, GitHub App, OTLP, and Sentry credentials. Set
+`DATABASE_URL`, `PX1_OBJECT_STORE_URL`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, and
+`SENTRY_DSN` as Fly secrets before deploying. Provider and GitHub private keys
+remain secrets and must never be placed in these manifests.
+
+Deploy staging first:
+
+```sh
+flyctl deploy --config deploy/fly/staging.toml
+```
+
+Promote the same tested image digest to production with the production config.
+Each process exposes `/healthz` and `/readyz`; structured startup logs, OTLP
+traces, and Sentry errors identify the environment, role, and release.

explanations.title: Adds a hosted runtime image
explanations.summary: Adds a production container build for `px1d`: it compiles the Go service, then runs it in a smaller, non-root distroless image on port 8080.

explanations.title: Runs the hosted HTTP server
explanations.summary: Starts an HTTP server with OpenTelemetry instrumentation and Sentry error reporting, and shuts the server down when it receives a termination signal.

explanations.title: Adds unconditional health endpoints
explanations.summary: Adds `/healthz` and `/readyz`, but both currently return success without checking dependencies or whether the process can serve its assigned work.

explanations.title: Adds a production deployment
explanations.summary: Adds a production Fly app configuration separate from staging, with its own app name, environment value, and VM sizing.

explanations.title: Defines hosted process roles
explanations.summary: Defines separate web, webhook, indexer, reviewer, and learner Fly processes, while routing public HTTP traffic only to web and webhook. Each process currently starts the same HTTP server; role-specific worker behavior is not implemented here.

explanations.title: Validates hosted configuration
explanations.summary: Hosted staging and production processes now fail at startup if database, object-store, OTLP, or Sentry configuration is missing. Role and environment values are also validated; local runs can use defaults.

explanations.title: Adds hosted telemetry
explanations.summary: When configured, the process exports traces to OTLP and reports errors to Sentry, tagging telemetry with the role, environment, and release. Shutdown flushes Sentry and the trace exporter.
